Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art tile for a dog shelter game.
Style: beautiful handcrafted pixel art, crisp small square pixels, dark brown 1–2 pixel outlines, rich detailed wood grain, cozy polished game sprite. Elevated near-overhead camera, around 75 degrees above ground with slight visible front faces for depth. Axis-aligned rectangular footprint: TOP and BOTTOM edges horizontal, LEFT and RIGHT edges vertical. NOT diamond isometric, no diagonal footprint. Same camera and consistent soft light from upper left for all.
All props INSIDE the fenced/walled square. All doors are actual wide open gaps exactly at the MIDPOINT of required edges, with a flat visible floor walkway reaching the very edge. Use low perimeter walls/fences with obvious missing sections for the gates. Gate width 20 percent of side. Internal broad walking aisle connects all gates through the middle; put props in quadrants, never blocking gates or aisles.
No dogs, no people, no letters, no text, no captions, no labels, no UI, no perspective background, no drop shadow outside tile. True transparent background alpha, no checkerboard drawn. Leave clear transparent margins around each isolated complete tile.
